citation: Cedernaes J, et al. 2014. Increased impulsivity in response to food cues after sleep loss in healthy young men. Obesity 22:1786.
protocol: One night of total sleep deprivation vs one night of normal sleep (8.5 h), crossover; morning fasting plasma glucose at 07:30 h
population: n=14 healthy young male students, age 22.3 +/- 0.5 y, BMI 22.4 +/- 0.5 kg/m2

reports.where: Results text, 07:30 fasting: 5.2 +/- 0.1 vs 5.4 +/- 0.1 mmol/l (TSD vs sleep)

note: One fasting time point only, plus hunger ratings; paper states data are mean +/- SEM. Fasting glucose is the only metabolic marker printed.
